title: Credit Note Terms: Cancellation-Fee Credit on Staged Endpoint Re-Quotes
content:
## Clause

The cancellation-fee credit on a Hardware Procurement staged re-quote follows the calendar days from the cancelled Standard Endpoint Order's cancellation date to the re-quote date:

(a) re-quoted within **2** days by a client with no ClearPath late fee posted on its ClearPath billing fewer than twelve whole months before the re-quote date, the whole cancellation fee charged on the cancelled order is credited;

(b) re-quoted within **7** days in any other case, the credit is the lesser of that cancellation fee and **25.00 USD** for each unit;

(c) re-quoted later, nothing is credited.

The credit is deducted from the re-quote total. The cancellation fee is the one on the cancelled order's own billing ledger; the late fees are the late fee entries on the billing ledger of the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement. "Within" a number of days includes that last day.

## Decision table

| Days from cancellation to re-quote | ClearPath late fee posted fewer than twelve whole months before the re-quote date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | none | the whole cancellation fee |
| 0 to 2 | one or more | the lesser of the fee and 25.00 for each unit |
| 3 to 7 | any | the lesser of the fee and 25.00 for each unit |
| 8 or more | any | nothing |

A client with no ClearPath agreement has no ClearPath late fee and is treated under (a) when it re-quotes within 2 days.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

A cancelled line of 10 units carried a cancellation fee of 300.00, so the per-unit cap is 10 times 25.00, that is 250.00.

- Re-quoted 1 day after cancellation, no ClearPath late fee in the period: 300.00 is credited.
- Re-quoted 1 day after cancellation with one ClearPath late fee posted five months earlier: the lesser of 300.00 and 250.00, that is 250.00.
- Re-quoted 6 days after cancellation: 250.00.
- With a fee of 180.00 instead, re-quoted 6 days after: the lesser of 180.00 and 250.00, that is 180.00.
- Re-quoted 9 days after cancellation: nothing.
